lines.gurmukhi: ਉਰ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਪਗੁ ਨਾ ਖਿਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ur na bheejai pag naa khisai har darasan kee aasaa ||1||
lines.translation: Her heart is not happy, but she does not retrace her steps, in hopes of seeing the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਡਹੁ ਨ ਕਾਗਾ ਕਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: udahu na kaagaa kaare ||
lines.translation: So fly away, black crow,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਗਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: beg mileejai apune raam piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: so that I may quickly meet my Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer jeevan pad kaaran har kee bhagat kareejai ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, to obtain the status of eternal life, worship the Lord with devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੪॥੬੫॥
lines.transliteration: ek aadhaar naam naaraain rasanaa raam raveejai ||2||1||14||65||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is my only Support; with my tongue, I chant the Lord's Name. ||2||1||14||65||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ੧੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee 11 ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree 11:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪਾਸ ਘਨ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਮਾਝ ਬਨਾ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਊਂ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aas paas ghan turasee kaa biravaa maajh banaa ras gaaoo(n) re ||
lines.translation: All around, there are thick bushes of sweet basil, and there in the midst of the forest, the Lord is singing with joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਗੁਆਰਨਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: uaa kaa saroop dekh mohee guaaran mo kau chhod na aau na jaahoo re ||1||
lines.translation: Beholding His wondrous beauty, the milk-maid was entranced, and said, "Please don't leave me; please don't come and go!" ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੋਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: tohi charan man laago saari(n)gadhar ||
lines.translation: My mind is attached to Your Feet, O Archer of the Universe;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੋ ਬਡਭਾਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: so milai jo badabhaago ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: he alone meets You, who is blessed by great good fortune. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨ ਮਨ ਹਰਨ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਗਾਊ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bi(n)draaban man haran manohar krisan charaavat gaaoo re ||
lines.translation: In Brindaaban, where Krishna grazes his cows, he entices and fascinates my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਨਾਊ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫॥੬੬॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa thaakur tuhee saari(n)gadhar mohi kabeeraa naaoo re ||2||2||15||66||
lines.translation: You are my Lord Master, the Archer of the Universe; my name is Kabeer. ||2||2||15||66||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ੧੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee poorabee 12 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Poorbee 12:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਪਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਹੈ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਬਨ ਮਧੇ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bipal basatr kete hai pahire kiaa ban madhe baasaa ||
lines.translation: Many people wear various robes, but what is the use of living in the forest?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਆ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ਧੋਖੇ ਕਿਆ ਜਲਿ ਬੋਰਿਓ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa bhaiaa nar devaa dhokhe kiaa jal borio giaataa ||1||
lines.translation: What good does it do if a man burns incense before his gods? What good does it do to dip one's body in water? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅਰੇ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeare jaahigaa mai jaanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: O soul, I know that I will have to depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਗਤ ਸਮਝੁ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: abigat samajh iaanaa ||
lines.translation: You ignorant idiot: understand the Imperishable Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jat jat dekhau bahur na pekhau sa(n)g maaiaa lapataanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever you see, you will not see that again, but still, you cling to Maya. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੀ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਗਲੋ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaanee dhiaanee bahu upadesee ihu jag sagalo dha(n)dhaa ||
lines.translation: The spiritual teachers, meditators and the great preachers are all engrossed in these worldly affairs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਧਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੬॥੬੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ik raam naam bin iaa jag maaiaa a(n)dhaa ||2||1||16||67||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, without the Name of the One Lord, this world is blinded by Maya. ||2||1||16||67||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ੧੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee 12 ||
lines.translation: Gauree 12:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਛਾਡਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਡਾਂਡੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re chhaadahu bharam pragat hoi naachahu iaa maaiaa ke daa(n)de ||
lines.translation: O people, O victims of this Maya, abandon your doubts and dance out in the open.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰੁ ਕਿ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਰਨ ਤੇ ਡਰਪੈ ਸਤੀ ਕਿ ਸਾਂਚੈ ਭਾਂਡੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: soor k sanamukh ran te darapai satee k saa(n)chai bhaa(n)de ||1||
lines.translation: What sort of a hero is one who is afraid to face the battle? What sort of satee is she who, when her time comes, starts collecting her pots and pans? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਗਮਗ ਛਾਡਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dagamag chhaad re man bauraa ||
lines.translation: Stop your wavering, O crazy people!

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਜਰੇ ਮਰੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਲੀਨੋ ਹਾਥਿ ਸੰਧਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab tau jare mare sidh paaeeai leeno haath sa(n)dhauraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Now that you have taken up the challenge of death, let yourself burn and die, and attain perfection. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਲੀਨੇ ਇਆ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh maaiaa ke leene iaa bidh jagat bigootaa ||
lines.translation: The world is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and Maya; in this way it is plundered and ruined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਸਗਲ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੭॥੬੮॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer raajaa raam na chhodau sagal ooch te oochaa ||2||2||17||68||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, do not forsake the Lord, your Sovereign King, the Highest of the High. ||2||2||17||68||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ੧੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee 13 ||
lines.translation: Gauree 13:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਿਰੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: phuramaan teraa sirai oopar phir na karat beechaar ||
lines.translation: Your Command is upon my head, and I no longer question it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਹੀ ਦਰੀਆ ਤੁਹੀ ਕਰੀਆ ਤੁਝੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tuhee dareeaa tuhee kareeaa tujhai te nisataar ||1||
lines.translation: You are the river, and You are the boatman; salvation comes from You. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਦੇ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਇਕਤੀਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)de ba(n)dagee ikateeaar ||
lines.translation: O human being, embrace the Lord's meditation,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰੋਸੁ ਧਰਉ ਕਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib ros dharau k piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: whether your Lord and Master is angry with you or in love with you. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਫੂਲੁ ਜਈ ਹੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam teraa aadhaar meraa jiu phool jaee hai naar ||
lines.translation: Your Name is my Support, like the flower blossoming in the water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਲਾਮੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਜੀਆਇ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੬੯॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer gulaam ghar kaa jeeaai bhaavai maar ||2||18||69||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, I am the slave of Your home; I live or die as You will. ||2||18||69||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₅ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee₅ ||
lines.translation: Gauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨੰਦੁ ਬਹੁ ਥਾਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jee jon mahi bhramat na(n)d bahu thaako re ||
lines.translation: Wandering through 8.4 million incarnations, Krishna's father Nand was totally exhausted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਲੀਓ ਹੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਬਡੋ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat het avataar leeo hai bhaag bado bapuraa ko re ||1||
lines.translation: Because of his devotion, Krishna was incarnated in his home; how great was the good fortune of this poor man! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਜੁ ਕਹਤ ਹਉ ਨੰਦ ਕੋ ਨੰਦਨੁ ਨੰਦ ਸੁ ਨੰਦਨੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumh j kahat hau na(n)d ko na(n)dan na(n)d s na(n)dan kaa ko re ||
lines.translation: You say that Krishna was Nand's son, but whose son was Nand himself?

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਨੰਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਥੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharan akaas daso dis naahee tab ihu na(n)d kahaa tho re ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When there was no earth or ether or the ten directions, where was this Nand then? ||1||Pause||
